purpose: Exercise the type boundary between Mycelix records, Symtropy simulation outputs, hypothetical independent measurements, and GCRB-derived claims. No record in this fixture asserts a real-world event or measurement.
limits: Every source_record_ref in this bundle is a synthetic placeholder, not a live Mycelix or Symtropy record.
Git blob SHAs identify source-code definitions only; they do not authenticate the synthetic example records.
The simulator build/scenario/config/output digests are placeholder strings, not hashes of executed artifacts.
The observed-class example describes a hypothetical measurement shape, not an actual observed water-service outcome.
Schema validity and successful type routing do not establish source truth, legal authority, capture completeness, or production interoperability.

records.claim: Synthetic example: a Mycelix Justice Cases record refers to a reviewable governance case. This asserts record presence in the fixture, not the truth of the allegation.
limitations: Synthetic fixture record only; no real case is being referenced.
Case existence does not establish the truth of submitted allegations or a legal finding.

records.claim: Synthetic example: a domain-specific signed event declares that a metric-definition revision was proposed. This does not establish that the revision was authorized or factually justified.
limitations: Credential-governance types are source references only; this synthetic record is not a real DeSci event.
A valid signature or event-chain position is not proof that the statement is true.

records.claim: Synthetic example: the simulator predicts water-service reliability of 0.92 over a declared future scenario window.

simulation_context.horizon: 10 synthetic ticks; not a calibrated real-world time conversion
simulation_context.validity_scope: A synthetic water-service scenario used to exercise evidence-class routing only.
limitations: All scenario values and digests are illustrative placeholders; no simulator run or build digest was produced.
Simulation output is not an observed water-service outcome.
No calibration or external validity is claimed.
Synthetic fixture record only; no actual simulation result is being asserted.
The current public SimSnapshot type is transient transport data; durable authenticated evidence ingestion is not implemented.

records.claim: Synthetic oracle example: a hypothetical independent measurement records service reliability of 0.84 over the declared synthetic window. This is not an actual municipal measurement.

observation_basis.measurement_method: Hypothetical calibrated meter plus independent sampling protocol; fixture example only.
quality_limits: No physical measurement exists; these values are only a schema example.
A deployed adapter must resolve the calibration, sampling frame, timestamp, location, and independent corroboration references.

limitations: The file is synthetic-only; the word observed describes the intended evidence class in the fixture, not a real-world fact.
Real observation claims require source authentication, appropriate measurement-quality evidence, and independent review.

records.claim: Synthetic arithmetic: the simulator forecast (0.92) exceeds the hypothetical measurement (0.84) by 0.08 for this fixture example.

assumptions: The two synthetic values refer to comparable measures, unit, location scope, and time horizon for this example only.
limitations: The comparison is arithmetic over placeholders, not a validated forecast-error result.
No policy-effect or causal claim follows from this difference.
Derived claim inherits all limitations and missing external validity of both inputs.
The derivation must remain classified inferred and cannot be promoted to observed merely because it combines a simulation and a measurement-shaped record.
